label: Core Engineering Focus
headline: AI as efficient as it is intelligent.
bio: I take AI into production for enterprise clients and own each system from design to support: agents that act within guardrails, and models sized to the latency budget and hardware they run on.

pillars.title: Tool-Using Agents
pillars.description: Agents built as production software: typed tools, fail-closed guardrails, and a named operator behind every change they make.

pillars.title: Resource-Aware AI
pillars.description: Trains and distils models on GPU, then serves small, quantized models on CPU that meet tight latency budgets without wasted compute.

pillars.title: Backend & Web Systems
pillars.description: The services and web applications AI features run inside, built with Rust and Java and owned from API design to production support.
